question: Identify the top 10 Citibike stations by highest proportion of group rides, defined as trips starting and ending at the same station where multiple riders departed/arrived within the same 2-minute time window. Calculate the proportion as the number of trips that are part of a group divided by the total number of trips ending at that station.

-- Good - 41126 group rides for station 2006, which matches. 
-- Now let me produce the final clean result. The question asks for:
-- 1. Station name or identifier
-- 2. Proportion of group rides (decimal)

-- I'll use the station name from the citibike_stations table when available, otherwise from trips.
-- Let me produce the final result.

WITH same_station_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_id,
        starttime,
        FLOOR(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM starttime) / 2) * 2 as two_min_window,
        DATE(starttime) as trip_date
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
station_window_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_id,
        two_min_window,
        trip_date,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM same_station_trips
    GROUP BY start_station_id, two_min_window, trip_date
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
group_trips AS (
    SELECT 
        s.start_station_id
    FROM same_station_trips s
    JOIN station_window_groups g
        ON s.start_station_id = g.start_station_id
        AND s.two_min_window = g.two_min_window
        AND s.trip_date = g.trip_date
),
total_trips_per_station AS (
    SELECT 
        end_station_id,
        end_station_name,
        COUNT(*) as total_trips_ending
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY end_station_id, end_station_name
),
station_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        end_station_id,
        SUM(total_trips_ending) as total_trips_ending
    FROM total_trips_per_station
    GROUP BY end_station_id
),
station_names AS (
    SELECT 
        end_station_id,
        end_station_name,
        SUM(total_trips_ending) as total_trips_ending
    FROM total_trips_per_station
    GROUP BY end_station_id, end_station_name
)
SELECT 
    t.end_station_id as station_id,
    COALESCE(s.name, n.end_station_name) as station_name,
    COUNT(*) as group_rides,
    t.total_trips_ending,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), t.total_trips_ending), 4) as proportion
FROM group_trips g
JOIN station_totals t
    ON g.start_station_id = t.end_station_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_stations` s
    ON CAST(g.start_station_id AS STRING) = s.station_id
JOIN station_names n
    ON g.start_station_id = n.end_station_id
GROUP BY t.end_station_id, s.name, n.end_station_name, t.total_trips_ending
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10
